name: Unverified Base arbitrage bot's selector 0x42be3129 makes arbitrary calls
summary: The unverified arbitrage bot exposed selector 0x42be3129, an unauthenticated arbitrary call plus token sweep. The attacker used it to spend the WETH allowance the bot's owner had granted the bot, taking 16.62 WETH.
notes: The bot never changed after deployment 15 months earlier. Loss is the owner wallet 0x38621874's WETH.
